items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: working with Sammy was always a gas... I worked there as a contractor for his band and lead saxophone player

ctx.x: Well, he -- working with Sammy was always a gas, because in my estimation, he is head and shoulders above all performance, so far as actually performing and doing his thing. I think he can follow anybody in this world as a performer and still do his thing and a lot of people that are supposed to be great performers wouldn't dare go on behind him.
